notes: Year-only shipment: the page states the year in text (2nd-3rd numerical digits) while the month is a first-letter code decoded only via the chart image (Laars-Date-of-Manufacture_Serial-Number-Nomenclature1.png), so month is held and year ships. The month chart is part of the same style, not a separate held style, so no shape collision arises. Digit-only counting gives the same year digits here (00) as character counting.

styles.notes: Page states year is the 2nd-3rd numerical digits. Month (1st letter) held: chart-only, no text table on the page.
